PR: Implement `CronOperation` and `WatchOperation` [closed]
### Description of your changes

This follows on from https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6594. See the design in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6557.

This PR implements the Operations framework for day-two operational capabilities in Crossplane. It adds `CronOperation` and `WatchOperation` types alongside the existing `Operation`.

`CronOperation` schedules operations using cron syntax. `WatchOperation` dynamically creates controllers to watch arbitrary Kubernetes resources and trigger

operations when they change. There's also a `watched` controller that handles the actual resource change events and creates operations from the template.

The `WatchOperation` controller creates a dynamic `watched` controller for each `WatchOperation` resource. When you create a `WatchOperation`, its controller starts a new controller instance that watches the specified resource type.
